caption:
Objects: clock, chair, refrigerator, cabinet, countertop, door, light fixture

clock 1: A round wall clock with a dark ornate scalloped metal frame, white face, black Roman numerals, and black hands indicating approximately 10:10.
chair 1: A wooden dining chair with a dark reddish-brown finish, featuring an intricately carved backrest with floral motifs and visible wear on the seat edge.
chair 2: A second wooden dining chair matching chair 1 in material, finish, and carved backrest design, showing similar signs of use on the seat surface.
refrigerator 1: A stainless steel side-by-side refrigerator with a brushed metallic finish, two vertical handles, and a visible water dispenser on the left door.
cabinet 1: A dark brown wooden upper cabinet with raised-panel doors, recessed hardware, and a smooth matte finish above the refrigerator.
countertop 1: A speckled granite countertop in beige and brown tones with fine granular texture and subtle veining, displaying a small crumpled foil packet and part of a green object at its edge.
door 1: A white paneled interior door with a six-panel design, a brass-colored lever handle, and a visible keyhole near the handle.
light fixture 1: A ceiling-mounted flush-mount light fixture with a white circular diffuser and a metallic rim, casting a soft glow downward.

Objects: painting, picture frame, sofa

painting 1: A large rectangular artwork with a white mat and light-colored frame, depicting an abstracted scene with dominant blue sky tones, tan architectural elements, and a circular motif resembling a wheel or archway rendered in pixelated or mosaic-like brushwork.
picture frame 1: A small, dark-framed rectangular picture hanging vertically on the wall, showing a narrow vertical composition with indistinct light and dark areas; the image content is not clearly discernible due to blur and angle.
picture frame 2: A second small, dark-framed rectangular picture mounted below the first, oriented horizontally, containing a composition of light and dark patches with no clearly identifiable subject due to motion blur and low resolution.
sofa 1: A dark brown leather sectional sofa with visible stitching along the armrests and back cushions, featuring multiple plush seat and back cushions arranged in an L-configuration, with a slightly glossy surface reflecting ambient light.

Objects: sofa, armchair, side table, fireplace, television, window blinds, curtain

sofa 1: A dark brown leather sectional sofa with deep tufted back cushions and visible stitching along the seams.
armchair 1: A matching dark brown leather armchair with a rounded backrest, padded armrests, and a slightly reclined posture.
side table 1: A small wooden side table with a reddish-brown finish, featuring a single drawer with a metal pull handle and an open lower shelf holding a few indistinct items.
fireplace 1: A white-painted mantel-style fireplace with a black rectangular firebox opening; the interior appears empty and dark, with no visible grate or logs.
television 1: A large flat-screen television mounted above the fireplace, displaying a dark screen with faint reflections of interior lighting and objects.
window blinds 1: White horizontal slat blinds covering a window, partially closed with slats angled downward, revealing a grid-like pattern of light and shadow.
window blinds 2: Another set of white horizontal slat blinds on a second window, similarly partially closed and showing consistent slat spacing and orientation.
curtain 1: A light gray fabric curtain hanging beside the first window, gathered at the top with visible folds and a slightly uneven hemline.
curtain 2: A matching light gray fabric curtain beside the second window, also gathered at the top with similar drape and texture, appearing slightly more rumpled.
